HitchabilityRatingDataFile.description: Absolute path (inside the container) to the CSV of per-country hitchability ratings. Columns: country_code,average_rating,ride_count. Regenerated from maps.hitchwiki.org — see data/README.md.

HitchabilityRatingMinRides.description: Minimum number of recorded rides required to show a rating. Countries with fewer rides (or with no data at all) render {{Unvalued}} instead.

HitchabilityRatingAliases.description: Maps wiki country codes used in <rating country='..'/> tags to the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes used in the CSV. E.g. the wiki uses 'uk' for the United Kingdom while the data uses the ISO code 'GB'. Keys and values are compared upper-cased.
